# @arki/ui
> React components for ARKI apps: Base UI primitives on Tailwind v4 semantic tokens. One subpath per component, no root import.
## Import paths
<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/ui/utils`: `cn`: join class names and resolve Tailwind conflicts. `cn`.
- `@arki/ui/cn`: `cn`: join class names and resolve Tailwind conflicts. `cn`.
- `@arki/ui/design-system`: The design-system ids from `@arki/design-systems`, plus the default id and a safe resolver for this package. `DESIGN_SYSTEMS`, `DESIGN_SYSTEM_IDS`, `defaultUiDesignSystemId`, `designSystemIdSchema`, `getDesignSystemById`, `getDesignSystemByIdSafe`, `isDesignSystemId`, `parseDesignSystemId`, `resolveUiDesignSystemId`; types `DesignSystemId`, `DesignSystemMetadata`.
- `@arki/ui/accordion`: `Accordion`, `AccordionContent`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`.
- `@arki/ui/alert`: `Alert`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertTitle`.
- `@arki/ui/alert-dialog`: `AlertDialog`, `AlertDialogAction`, `AlertDialogCancel`, `AlertDialogContent`, `AlertDialogDescription`, `AlertDialogFooter`, `AlertDialogHeader`, `AlertDialogOverlay`, `AlertDialogPortal`, `AlertDialogTitle`, `AlertDialogTrigger`.
- `@arki/ui/aspect-ratio`: `AspectRatio`.
- `@arki/ui/avatar`: `Avatar`, `AvatarFallback`, `AvatarImage`.
- `@arki/ui/badge`: `Badge`, `badgeVariants`.

## Start here
- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): read first for tasks and rules. No root import; unstyled output means `@source` is missing; one design system per app.
